cases.reason: Ineligible. The fraud campaign is the same bounded operation that began with malicious activity on 2026-08-01, before the 2026-09-10 elicitation/start date. Adding AI on 2026-09-12 increases harm but does not create a new campaign onset; later harms from this incident are excluded.

Eligible. This is stipulated to be a distinct, operationally separate hospital ransomware campaign, and its first malicious action against a target is 2026-09-12, within the 2026-09-10 to 2030-12-31 onset interval. Count attributable harms within its first three years after onset.
Ineligible. The campaign onset was the first intrusion on 2026-08-01, before the counting interval. Later encryption on 2026-09-12 in the same campaign does not reset onset; later harms are excluded.

Ineligible. The report on 2026-09-12 merely reveals a campaign that began in August before the interval. Discovery or reporting does not reset onset; harms from the pre-interval campaign are excluded.
Ineligible. The worm campaign began on 2026-09-09, before the 2026-09-10 start date. Continued propagation to additional victims on 2026-09-12 is the same campaign and does not create a new onset.

Eligible. August code development was only planning/tool development and did not act against targets. The distinct campaign's first malicious action against a target was 2026-09-12, within the onset interval; count harms within its first three years after that onset.

Eligible. The campaign onset is 2030-12-30, which is within the inclusive by-2030 onset interval ending 2030-12-31. Losses in January 2031 may count because harm after the interval end is included if within the incident's first three years after onset.

Ineligible for this new elicitation. With elicitation on 2027-01-10, the new by-2030 onset interval starts 2027-01-10; this ongoing campaign's onset was 2026-09-12, before that interval. Ongoing activity does not create a new incident onset.
